latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of In One Video — Merge Clips Into One Video.
- Upload multiple video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB), merge them into a single 1080p MP4 with smooth transitions via a cloud backend.
- No editing software required — describe your goal (e.g., "combine all my clips into one video"), download the ready-to-post result.
- Automatic secure setup: connects to rendering backend and manages tokens for you.
- Supports common workflows: quick edits, batch processing, iterative refinement, and credit/balance tracking.
- Handles common errors (unsupported file, file too large, token/session/auth issues) with clear guidance.
